title: Security overview
description: Detections (alerts with ATT&CK labels), logins and Gateway requests. Click a client to investigate it.

panels.title: Firing now
panels.description: Detections (alerts with ATT&CK labels) firing now.

targets.expr: count(ALERTS{alertstate="firing", mitre_tactic!=""}) or vector(0)

panels.title: Fired in range
panels.description: Alert instances the detections raised in the time range (VictoriaMetrics keeps 7 days).

targets.expr: count(count_over_time(ALERTS{alertstate="firing", mitre_tactic!=""}[$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Failed logins
panels.description: Wrong passwords and TOTP codes in Authelia, failed Vaultwarden logins.

targets.expr: _time:$__range {event.dataset=~"authelia.log|vaultwarden.log"} event.outcome:=failure event.action:in("password-login", "totp-login") -event.reason:="unknown user" | count() as failures

panels.title: Authelia logins
panels.description: Completed Authelia logins (password and TOTP), from the Gateway's logs.

targets.expr: _time:$__range {event.dataset="envoy.access"} http.request.method:=POST http.response.status_code:=200 url.domain:="auth.hirednoobs.com" url.path:="/api/secondfactor/totp" | count() as logins

panels.title: Refused requests
panels.description: 401/403/404 responses at the Gateway, blackbox probes excluded.

targets.expr: _time:$__range {event.dataset="envoy.access"} http.response.status_code:in(401, 403, 404) -user_agent.original:"Blackbox-Exporter"* | count() as refused

panels.title: Sensitive requests
panels.description: Scanner paths and sensitive actions (silences, deletes, Grafana users, Vaultwarden's admin panel) at the Gateway.

targets.expr: _time:$__range {event.dataset="envoy.access"} (url.original:~"(?i)(/\\.env|/\\.git/|/\\.aws/|wp-login\\.php|/wp-admin|phpmyadmin|/cgi-bin/|\\.\\./|%2e%2e)" or (url.domain:="alertmanager.hirednoobs.com" http.request.method:=POST url.path:="/api/v2/silences") or (url.domain:="victoriametrics.hirednoobs.com" url.path:~"^/api/v1/admin/tsdb/delete_series") or (url.domain:="victorialogs.hirednoobs.com" url.path:~"^/delete/") or (url.domain:="grafana.hirednoobs.com" http.request.method:in("POST", "PUT", "PATCH", "DELETE") url.path:~"^/api/(admin/users|org/users)") or (url.domain:="vaultwarden.hirednoobs.com" url.path:~"^/admin")) -http.response.status_code:=302 | count() as requests

panels.title: Detections by tactic
panels.description: Firing detections over time, by ATT&CK tactic.

targets.expr: count by (mitre_tactic) (ALERTS{alertstate="firing", mitre_tactic!=""})

panels.title: Detections in range
panels.description: Each detection's alert instances in the time range.

targets.expr: count by (alertname, mitre_tactic, mitre_technique, severity) (count_over_time(ALERTS{alertstate="firing", mitre_tactic!=""}[$__range]))

panels.title: Firing now
panels.description: Detections firing now, with the labels their rule extracted. Click a client to investigate it.

targets.expr: ALERTS{alertstate="firing", mitre_tactic!=""}

panels.title: Login failures
panels.description: Authelia: wrong passwords and TOTP codes (its logs). Vaultwarden: failed logins, which it logs the same for a wrong password and an unknown account.

targets.expr: {event.dataset="authelia.log"} event.action:=password-login event.outcome:=failure -event.reason:="unknown user" | stats count() as failures
{event.dataset="authelia.log"} event.action:=totp-login event.outcome:=failure | stats count() as failures
{event.dataset="vaultwarden.log"} event.action:=password-login event.outcome:=failure | stats count() as failures

panels.title: Successful logins
panels.description: From the Gateway's logs: completed Authelia logins, and Vaultwarden logins or token refreshes (clients refresh about hourly; the log can't tell them apart).

targets.expr: {event.dataset="envoy.access"} http.request.method:=POST http.response.status_code:=200 ((url.domain:="auth.hirednoobs.com" url.path:="/api/secondfactor/totp") or (url.domain:="vaultwarden.hirednoobs.com" url.path:="/identity/connect/token")) | copy url.domain as host | stats by (host) count() as logins

panels.title: Authelia failures
panels.description: Failed Authelia logins (password or TOTP) by user and client.

targets.expr: _time:$__range {event.dataset="authelia.log"} event.outcome:=failure event.action:in("password-login", "totp-login") -event.reason:="unknown user" | copy user.name as user, source.ip as remote_ip, event.action as factor | stats by (user, remote_ip, factor) count() as failures, max(_time) as _time | sort by (failures desc) | limit 50

panels.title: Vaultwarden failures
panels.description: Failed Vaultwarden logins by user and client.

targets.expr: _time:$__range {event.dataset="vaultwarden.log"} event.action:=password-login event.outcome:=failure | copy user.name as user, source.ip as remote_ip | stats by (user, remote_ip) count() as failures, max(_time) as _time | sort by (failures desc) | limit 50

panels.title: Logins by client
panels.description: Successful logins (and Vaultwarden token refreshes) by site and client.

targets.expr: _time:$__range {event.dataset="envoy.access"} http.request.method:=POST http.response.status_code:=200 ((url.domain:="auth.hirednoobs.com" url.path:="/api/secondfactor/totp") or (url.domain:="vaultwarden.hirednoobs.com" url.path:="/identity/connect/token")) | copy source.ip as remote_ip, url.domain as host | stats by (host, remote_ip) count() as logins, max(_time) as _time | sort by (logins desc) | limit 50

panels.title: Clients with refused requests
panels.description: 401/403/404 responses by client (blackbox probes excluded), and how many distinct paths: many paths is scanning, one path repeated is a misconfigured client.

targets.expr: _time:$__range {event.dataset="envoy.access"} http.response.status_code:in(401, 403, 404) -user_agent.original:"Blackbox-Exporter"* | copy source.ip as remote_ip | stats by (remote_ip) count() as refused, count_uniq(url.original) as paths, uniq_values(url.original) limit 5 as examples, max(_time) as _time | replace_regexp ("^\\[\\]$|^\\[\"|\"\\]$", "") at examples | replace ("\",\"", ", ") at examples | replace ("\\\"", "\"") at examples | replace ("\\u0027", "'") at examples | replace ("\\u003c", "<") at examples | replace ("\\u003e", ">") at examples | replace ("\\u0026", "&") at examples | sort by (refused desc) | limit 20

panels.title: Sensitive requests
panels.description: Scanner paths and sensitive actions (the Envoy detections' filters) by client, site and path. Logged-out requests (302) are left out.

targets.expr: _time:$__range {event.dataset="envoy.access"} (url.original:~"(?i)(/\\.env|/\\.git/|/\\.aws/|wp-login\\.php|/wp-admin|phpmyadmin|/cgi-bin/|\\.\\./|%2e%2e)" or (url.domain:="alertmanager.hirednoobs.com" http.request.method:=POST url.path:="/api/v2/silences") or (url.domain:="victoriametrics.hirednoobs.com" url.path:~"^/api/v1/admin/tsdb/delete_series") or (url.domain:="victorialogs.hirednoobs.com" url.path:~"^/delete/") or (url.domain:="grafana.hirednoobs.com" http.request.method:in("POST", "PUT", "PATCH", "DELETE") url.path:~"^/api/(admin/users|org/users)") or (url.domain:="vaultwarden.hirednoobs.com" url.path:~"^/admin")) -http.response.status_code:=302 | copy source.ip as remote_ip, http.request.method as method, url.domain as host, url.original as path, http.response.status_code as response_code | stats by (remote_ip, method, host, path, response_code) count() as requests, max(_time) as _time | sort by (requests desc) | limit 50

panels.title: lldap-bootstrap changes
panels.description: What the hourly lldap-bootstrap reverted: users, groups and memberships that differed from git.

targets.expr: {event.dataset="lldap.bootstrap"} (event.category:=iam or log.level:=warning)

panels.title: lldap logins
panels.description: lldap's login attempts (its UI). It doesn't log whether they worked, and sees the Gateway's address, not the client's.

targets.expr: {event.dataset="lldap.log"} event.action:=password-login

panels.title: Changes outside Flux
panels.description: Writes to any object by someone other than the control plane and the controllers deployed from git (dry runs left out): people with kubectl, or a service account that shouldn't be writing.

targets.expr: _time:$__range {event.dataset="kubernetes.audit"} verb:in("create", "update", "patch", "delete", "deletecollection") -user.name:~"^system:(node:.*|kube-.*|apiserver|serviceaccount:(flux-system|kube-system|longhorn-system|reloader|envoy-gateway|rabbitmq-system|cert-manager|external-secrets):.*)$" -requestURI:~"dryRun=" -objectRef.subresource:in("exec", "attach", "portforward") | copy user.name as user, source.ip as remote_ip, objectRef.resource as resource, objectRef.namespace as namespace | stats by (user, remote_ip, verb, resource, namespace) count() as requests, uniq_values(objectRef.name) limit 5 as examples, max(_time) as _time | replace_regexp ("^\\[\\]$|^\\[\"|\"\\]$", "") at examples | replace ("\",\"", ", ") at examples | replace ("\\\"", "\"") at examples | replace ("\\u0027", "'") at examples | replace ("\\u003c", "<") at examples | replace ("\\u003e", ">") at examples | replace ("\\u0026", "&") at examples | sort by (requests desc) | limit 50

panels.title: Sensitive API activity
panels.description: exec/attach/port-forward, Secret reads (the controllers' reads aren't logged) and refused (403) requests, by user.

targets.expr: _time:$__range {event.dataset="kubernetes.audit"} (objectRef.subresource:in("exec", "attach", "portforward") or (objectRef.resource:=secrets verb:in("get", "list", "watch")) or responseStatus.code:=403) | format if (objectRef.resource:=secrets) "secret read" as kind | format if (objectRef.subresource:in("exec", "attach", "portforward")) "<objectRef.subresource>" as kind | format if (responseStatus.code:=403) "forbidden" as kind | copy user.name as user, source.ip as remote_ip, objectRef.namespace as namespace | stats by (user, remote_ip, kind, namespace) count() as requests, uniq_values(objectRef.name) limit 5 as examples, max(_time) as _time | replace_regexp ("^\\[\\]$|^\\[\"|\"\\]$", "") at examples | replace ("\",\"", ", ") at examples | replace ("\\\"", "\"") at examples | replace ("\\u0027", "'") at examples | replace ("\\u003c", "<") at examples | replace ("\\u003e", ">") at examples | replace ("\\u0026", "&") at examples | sort by (requests desc) | limit 50

panels.title: Falco events by priority
panels.description: Every Falco event (Notice and above). Warning and above are alerted (FalcoRuntimeAlert), Notice only shows here.

targets.expr: {event.dataset="falco.alert"} | stats by (log.level) count() as events

panels.title: Falco events by rule
panels.description: Which Falco rules fired, where. The events themselves: {event.dataset="falco.alert"} rule.name:="<rule>" in VictoriaLogs.

targets.expr: _time:$__range {event.dataset="falco.alert"} | copy rule.name as rule, log.level as level, orchestrator.namespace as namespace, orchestrator.resource.name as pod | stats by (rule, level, namespace, pod) count() as events, uniq_values(process.command_line) limit 3 as examples, max(_time) as _time | replace_regexp ("^\\[\\]$|^\\[\"|\"\\]$", "") at examples | replace ("\",\"", ", ") at examples | replace ("\\\"", "\"") at examples | replace ("\\u0027", "'") at examples | replace ("\\u003c", "<") at examples | replace ("\\u003e", ">") at examples | replace ("\\u0026", "&") at examples | sort by (events desc) | limit 50

panels.title: Falco messages (repeated lines counted)
panels.description: Falco's messages with numbers, IPs and dates collapsed (collapse_nums), so the same event repeated is one row with its count.

targets.expr: _time:$__range {event.dataset="falco.alert"} | collapse_nums prettify | copy rule.name as rule, log.level as level | stats by (level, rule, _msg) count() as events, max(_time) as _time | sort by (events desc) | limit 50

panels.title: SSH logins
panels.description: Accepted SSH logins on the prx-999 VMs.

targets.expr: _time:$__range {_SYSTEMD_UNIT="ssh.service"} "Accepted " | extract_regexp "Accepted (?P<method>\\S+) for (?P<user>\\S+) from (?P<remote_ip>\\S+) port" | copy _HOSTNAME as host | stats by (host, user, remote_ip) count() as logins, max(_time) as _time | sort by (logins desc) | limit 50

panels.title: sudo
panels.description: Commands run with sudo, by host and user (Ansible runs as hirednoobs).

targets.expr: _time:$__range {_HOSTNAME=~"prx-999-.*"} SYSLOG_IDENTIFIER:=sudo "COMMAND=" -"NOT in sudoers" -"incorrect password attempt" -"a password is required" | extract_regexp "^\\s*(?P<user>\\S+) : " | extract "COMMAND=<command>" | copy _HOSTNAME as host | stats by (host, user) count() as commands, uniq_values(command) limit 5 as examples, max(_time) as _time | replace_regexp ("^\\[\\]$|^\\[\"|\"\\]$", "") at examples | replace ("\",\"", ", ") at examples | replace ("\\\"", "\"") at examples | replace ("\\u0027", "'") at examples | replace ("\\u003c", "<") at examples | replace ("\\u003e", ">") at examples | replace ("\\u0026", "&") at examples | sort by (commands desc) | limit 50

panels.title: Vault requests
panels.description: Vault's audit log (responses) by identity and client, with how many failed.

targets.expr: _time:$__range {_SYSTEMD_UNIT="vault.service"} "\"type\":\"response\"" | unpack_json fields (request.path, auth.display_name, request.remote_address, error, response.data.error) | copy auth.display_name as identity, request.remote_address as remote_ip | stats by (identity, remote_ip) count() as requests, count() if (error:~"." or response.data.error:~".") as errors, uniq_values(request.path) limit 5 as examples, max(_time) as _time | replace_regexp ("^\\[\\]$|^\\[\"|\"\\]$", "") at examples | replace ("\",\"", ", ") at examples | replace ("\\\"", "\"") at examples | replace ("\\u0027", "'") at examples | replace ("\\u003c", "<") at examples | replace ("\\u003e", ">") at examples | replace ("\\u0026", "&") at examples | sort by (requests desc) | limit 50

panels.title: prx-999 journal warnings and errors (repeated lines counted)
panels.description: The VMs' journal lines at warning or worse (Vault's audit log excluded), with numbers, IPs and dates collapsed (collapse_nums), so the same line repeated is one row with its count.

targets.expr: _time:$__range {_HOSTNAME=~"prx-999-.*"} PRIORITY:<=4 -_SYSTEMD_UNIT:="vault.service" | collapse_nums prettify | copy _HOSTNAME as host, SYSLOG_IDENTIFIER as program | stats by (host, program, _msg) count() as lines, max(_time) as _time | sort by (lines desc) | limit 50
